items.text: Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame that caused unintended damage.
Increased radiation output of radwater sprinklers: doubled output and an additional 1.5× boost.
Added initial rabbit interest behavior (work in progress).
Implemented an initial squirrel interest mechanic, allowing squirrels to react to player presence.
Added monument blockers to the red key card doors in Underwater Labs, preventing unauthorized entry.
Fixed duplicate fuse insert clan events when multiple fuses are added in one container session.
Introduced a placeholder Milk item for livestock processing.
Fixed Russian Roulette storage acceptance logic and updated prefab/localization.
Fixed a rare null reference error when zooming with a scoped weapon and removed an unnecessary memory allocation on each zoom.

2026-09-01.summary:
### Combat & Vehicles
- Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame that caused unintended damage.

### Environment & Hazards
- Increased radiation output of radwater sprinklers: doubled output and an additional 1.5× boost.

### AI & Wildlife
- Added initial rabbit interest behavior (work in progress).
- Implemented an initial squirrel interest mechanic, allowing squirrels to react to player presence.

### Base & Clan Mechanics
- Added monument blockers to the red key card doors in Underwater Labs, preventing unauthorized entry.
- Fixed duplicate fuse insert clan events when multiple fuses are added in one container session.

### Items & DLC
- Introduced a placeholder Milk item for livestock processing.
- Fixed Russian Roulette storage acceptance logic and updated prefab/localization.

### Performance & Stability
- Fixed a rare null reference error when zooming with a scoped weapon and removed an unnecessary memory allocation on each zoom.

items.text: Fixed scale override on large rig monument blocker that caused collision issues and added missing vent cages.
Pipe access fixes: prevented trees from spawning inside pipes, improved terrain transition near pipes, and added beach to water pipe topology.
Improved deployment of carvable pumpkins.
Footstep sounds now play correctly when players are heavily armored or wearing diving fins while slowed.
Fixed a typo that prevented sleepers from being killed in safezones after a server restart.
Animals will now eat from troughs, prioritizing them over grazing on grass.
Added shearing interaction for livestock.
Large rig monument blocker collision fixed and missing vent cages added to monuments.
Beach area added to water pipe topology, expanding pipe placement options near coastlines.
Pipe access improved: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.
Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.
New shearing interaction lets players shear livestock for resources.
Carvable pumpkin deployment improved for more reliable placement.
Footstep sounds now play correctly when heavily armored or wearing diving fins, restoring audio feedback while moving.
High-Quality Metal collectable now displays its proper name token, fixing missing label issues.

2026-08-31.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Large rig monument blocker collision fixed and missing vent cages added to monuments.
- Beach area added to water pipe topology, expanding pipe placement options near coastlines.

### Base Building
- Pipe access improved: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.

### Gameplay Bugs
- Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.

### Animals & Farming
- New shearing interaction lets players shear livestock for resources.

### Deployables
- Carvable pumpkin deployment improved for more reliable placement.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Footstep sounds now play correctly when heavily armored or wearing diving fins, restoring audio feedback while moving.

### UI & Quality of Life
- High-Quality Metal collectable now displays its proper name token, fixing missing label issues.

items.text: Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).
Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.
